Simulate a toy information integration score

Source: R/simulate_information_integration.R
simulate_information_integration.Rd

simulate_information_integration() creates a simple network of components and estimates an educational integration score based on connectivity, shared activity, and differentiation.

Usage

simulate_information_integration(
  n_components = 8,
  steps = 100,
  connection_probability = 0.3,
  coupling = 0.4,
  noise = 0.1,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

n_components

Number of components in the system.

steps

Number of time steps.

connection_probability

Probability of a connection between components.

coupling

Strength of influence among connected components.

noise

Amount of random fluctuation.

seed

Optional random seed.

Value

A list with a time series, adjacency matrix, and summary score.

Details

This function is inspired by information-integration ideas, but it is not an implementation of Integrated Information Theory and does not compute phi.

Examples

info <- simulate_information_integration(seed = 1)
info$summary
#>   mean_connectivity shared_information differentiation integration_score
#> 1           0.40625          0.1653532       0.3432453        0.02305742
